about_the_game:
The DLC contains:

Digital Artbook

Step into the world of Lord Ambermaze with over 60 pages of atmospheric artwork, concept art, and illustrations. Learn more about the mystery of the Dark Lord and the magical creatures that inhabit the labyrinth. Take a look at early concepts for characters and locations that didn’t make it into the final game. Some of the content included in the artbook has never been shown anywhere else.

Please note that the Lord Ambermaze — Artbook contains story spoilers.

Original Soundtrack

Feel the eerie charm of Lord Ambermaze with 20 atmospheric tracks that pull you into a world of mystery, shifting labyrinths, and strange creatures. Let the music guide you through every puzzle and trap on your journey through the labyrinth!
